svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Topology view in 3D: the causal path of INC-2041
svg.desc: The Atlas Topology view (Alt+2) rendered as a 3D service graph in perspective. About 45 services float as spheres sized by traffic on four faint glass tier planes: edge at the top, then services, dependencies, and data stores on the ground. Bundled curved edge arcs carry dashed particles. The causal path checkout ⟶ payments ⟶ psp-api is a lit tube; psp-api, the probable origin (⊕), outside the estate, carries a tall thin light beacon. Victims are desaturated with dashed rings on their tier plane, a ⚙ 12:19 timeout config change floats at payments, and off-path services recede into depth fog. HUD: top bar, view switcher, Orbit/Map/Fly mode chip, orbit gizmo, A0–A5 ladder, minimap, Inspector, First Light strip and Time Ribbon.
